title: 第二十一章 忮忌的周欣甜又蹦出来了第二十二章 最小师叔祖
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 秦征弋在九幽玄猫嚎叫的时候就过来了，范沐禾话音刚落，他人已至。
被两个合体大能盯着，即便是性情再高傲的九幽玄猫也要炸毛了。
小灵鼩就更不用说了，一头扎进玄稷怀里瑟瑟发抖。
“九幽玄猫怎么会出现在这？”
九幽玄猫专门以阴煞之气或是魂魄为食，生在九幽地狱的阴属性灵兽，天生隐匿敛息的高手。
这只还是金丹期的修为，怪不得他们进来这么久都没有发现。
玄稷小肉手捏起吞噬灵鼩的尾巴，倒吊着给众人看，“小猫是追着小老鼠来的。”
秦征弋看到吞噬灵鼩了然点头。
“这小家伙别看只有你手心那么大点，天生能破结界，会寻宝，你好好养亏不了。”
小灵鼩也有筑基后期的修为了。
玄稷一听这小老鼠会寻宝，眼睛就亮了，她喜欢宝贝啊！
秦征弋深深的看了玄稷一眼，明明是凡人小娃，运气却这么好，还能引起天地规则契约这两只不凡的灵兽。
要说她不是天道宠儿，他都不信。
也更加坚信范沐禾的话，离开囚笼界的契机，定在这小娃身上了。
过来的掌门见状，羡慕的眼睛红了。
那凡人小娃，是怎么跟两只高阶灵兽签订契约的？
“我们先离开吧。”
自己是合体大能，加上范沐禾，在灵植园里再待下去，那些灵植是吸收不到灵气的，都自动被他两个给吸了，还有眼前这小娃也在不由自主的吸收灵气。
再不走灵植园里的灵芝全都得枯死。
一刻钟后。
秦征弋洞府前，大胖正追着那只九幽玄猫，九幽玄猫追着那只吞噬灵鼩。
大胖：“汪汪！阴险卑鄙无耻的猫，竟然敢占我主人便宜！
你有什么脸能成为我主人的灵兽，长得那么小又那么丑，不能当坐骑，也不能当打手，更不当吃不当喝的！
给我主人提鞋都不配，你个阴损玩意！”
九幽玄猫：“喵喵！你以为老子想吗？
老子是被你主人自己契约的！
老子这么高贵的血统，竟然还比不过一个人类幼崽的血统高贵成了奴仆，找谁说理去！
都是这只死老鼠惹的祸，本喵今天定要把你这只死老鼠给吃了！”
签订主播契约后，它就感受到自己的小主人，血脉直接碾压自己。
这让它有一点郁闷，想解约都解不了。
吞噬灵鼩：“啾啾啾~嘤嘤嘤，主人救命，小鼩鼩怕怕~~”
三只围着玄稷转圈的跑。
九幽玄猫和吞噬灵鼩跟着玄稷回来，大胖直接原地生气。
得知那两只还和小主人签订了什么主仆契约就更气了。
追着两只就要打。
玄稷当然是站在大胖这边的，所以不准那小老鼠往自己身上跳，就造成了眼前的局面。
玄稷听着那三只你说我吵的，小脑瓜子嗡嗡的，摸出了一颗清心果啃起来。
她想要静一静。
玄稷脆脆的咬了一口嚼嚼嚼。
第一个停下的是那吞噬灵鼩，紧接着九幽玄猫也停下了。
两小只仰着头，看着吃清心果的玄稷，哈喇子直接馋下来了。
“呔！吃老娘一爪！”
大胖见到这好时机，直接一爪子按住九幽玄猫。
content_en:
Qin Zhengyi came over when the Nine Nether Black Cat howled. As soon as Fan Muhe finished speaking, others had already arrived.
Being stared at by two combined powerful men, even the most arrogant Jiuyou Xuanmao would be furious.
Not to mention the little shrew, which plunged into Xuan Ji's arms and shivered.
"Why did the Nine Nether Black Cat appear here?"
The Nine Nether Black Cat specializes in feeding on Yin evil energy or souls. It is a Yin attribute spirit beast born in the Nine Nether Hell, and is a natural master of concealment and breathing.
This one was still at the Golden Core stage, no wonder they didn't notice it after coming in for so long.
Xuan Ji pinched the Devouring Spirit Shrew's tail with his little fleshy hands and hung it upside down for everyone to see, "The kitten is chasing the little mouse."
Qin Zhengyi nodded clearly when he saw the swallowing spirit shrew.
"Although this little guy is only as big as the palm of your hand, he is born to be able to break barriers and hunt for treasures. You can't take care of him."
The little shrew also has the cultivation level in the late stage of foundation building.
When Xuan Ji heard that this little mouse could hunt for treasures, her eyes lit up. She liked treasures!
Qin Zhengyi took a deep look at Xuan Ji. He was obviously a mortal child, but he was so lucky that he could cause the two extraordinary spiritual beasts to contract with the rules of heaven and earth.
He didn't believe that she was not the darling of heaven.
He also believed even more firmly in Fan Muhe's words that the opportunity to leave the cage world was determined to be with this little baby.
When the leader who came over saw this, his eyes turned red with envy.
How did a mortal kid sign a contract with two high-level spiritual beasts?
"Let's leave first."
He is a combined power, and Fan Muhe, if he stays in the spiritual plant garden any longer, those spiritual plants will not be able to absorb spiritual energy, so they will be sucked by him automatically. The little kid in front of him is also absorbing spiritual energy involuntarily.
If we don't leave, all the Ganoderma lucidum in the Lingzhi Garden will wither.
A quarter of an hour later.
In front of Qin Zhengyi's cave, Big Fatty was chasing the Nine Nether Black Cat, and the Nine Nether Black Cat was chasing the Devouring Spirit Shrew.
Big Fatty: "Woof woof! This sinister, despicable and shameless cat actually dares to take advantage of my master!
How dare you become my master's spiritual beast? It's so small and ugly. It can't be a mount or a thug, let alone eat or drink!
You're not even worthy of carrying my master's shoes, you shady thing! "
Jiuyou Xuanmao: "Meow meow! Do you think I want it?
I was contracted by your master himself!
I have such a noble bloodline, but it is not as noble as the bloodline of a human cub and became a slave. Who can I ask to explain!
This dead mouse is all the fault. I will definitely eat you, this dead mouse, today! "
After signing the anchor contract, it felt that its little master's blood directly crushed itself.
This makes it a bit depressing, and it can't be terminated even if it wants to.
Devouring Spirit Shrew: "Chirp, chirp, chirp~ 嘤嘤嘤, master, help me, the little shrew is afraid~~"
Three of them were running in circles around Xuanji.
The Nine Nether Black Cat and Devouring Spirit Shrew followed Xuan Ji back, and the big fat man was angry on the spot.
I was even more angry when I learned that those two had signed a master-servant contract with their little master.
If you chase two of them, you will fight them.
Of course Xuan Ji was on Big Fatty's side, so he didn't allow the little mouse to jump on him, which resulted in the situation in front of him.
Xuanji's little head was buzzing as he listened to the three noisy ones. He took out a Qingxin fruit and started to chew on it.
She wanted to be quiet.
"Click——"
Xuan Ji took a crispy bite and chewed it.
The first one to stop was the Devouring Spirit Shrew, followed closely by the Nine Nether Black Cat.
The two little ones raised their heads and looked at Xuan Ji who was eating the Qingxin fruit, and Halazi became greedy.
"Hey! Eat my claws!"
Seeing this good opportunity, Big Fatty directly held down the Nine Nether Cat with his paw.
